definitions.gloss: falling asleep unintentionally; dozing off while doing something
definitions.explanation: the act of falling asleep without meaning to, often while using a phone, watching TV, or chatting online

examples.japanese: スマホを{見|み}ながら{寝落|ねお}ちした。
examples.english: I fell asleep while looking at my phone.

examples.japanese: {電話中|でんわちゅう}に{寝落|ねお}ちしてしまった。
examples.english: I accidentally fell asleep while on the phone.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|さくや}は{映画|えいが}を{見|み}ていたら{寝落|ねお}ちして、{最後|さいご}まで{見|み}られなかった。
examples.english: Last night I fell asleep while watching a movie and couldn't finish it.

notes:
FORMATION:
{寝|ね} (sleep) + {落|お}ちる (to fall) → to fall into sleep

VERB FORM:
{寝落|ねお}ちする (to fall asleep unintentionally)

MODERN USAGE:
This term became popular with the rise of smartphones and online communication. It's commonly used when:
- Falling asleep while texting or on social media
- Dozing off during an online video call
- Falling asleep while gaming

COMMON CONTEXTS:
- LINEで{話|はな}していて{寝落|ねお}ちした (fell asleep while chatting on LINE)
- {通話|つうわ}{中|ちゅう}に{寝落|ねお}ち (falling asleep during a call)
- ゲーム{中|ちゅう}に{寝落|ねお}ち (falling asleep while gaming)

RELATED WORDS:
- うたた{寝|ね} (dozing off lightly)
- {居眠|いねむ}り (nodding off while sitting)
- {仮眠|かみん} (intentional nap)
